metadata.title: Rational decomposition of polyhedra and a conjecture of Brlek and Reutenauer
metadata.abstract: We prove in the affirmative a conjecture of Brlek and Reutenauer (2003), which relates unambiguous rational sets to a well known result due to Khovanskii and Pukhlikov (1992) and independently to Lawrence (1990) on the valuations of the algebra spanned by the indicator functions of polyhedra.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明 Brlek–Reutenauer 关于无歧义有理集与多面体示性函数代数赋值理论之间联系的猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 连接形式语言的有理结构与多面体分解工具。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。摘要极简，未列精确定理及证明步骤，暂不判断其对连续几何问题的进一步应用。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
